import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { Then, When } from '@cucumber/cucumber';

When('I map a blocked review result', async function () {
  const { combinedResultState, createResult } = await import(
    process.env.BDD_CORPUS_RESULT_RUNTIME!
  );
  const blocked = createResult({ state: 'action_required' });
  this.result = {
    state: process.env.BDD_CORPUS_DEFECT === '1'
      ? combinedResultState([])
      : combinedResultState([blocked]),
  };
});
Then('the contract state is {string}', function (state: string) {
  assert.equal(this.result.state, state);
});
